title: Blossom
tagline: Seamlessly authenticate, verify your unique identity, and delve into comprehensive blockchain data with user-friendly tools and intuitive interfaces
description:
Blockchain Explorer with Easy Login and ID Check
This project is a user-friendly tool for exploring blockchain information. It offers:
Simple Login: Use Alchemy to log in quickly and safely.
Blockchain Info: See details about transactions and how much money is in different addresses.
Unique ID: Check that you're a unique user with World ID.
Perfect for anyone interested in blockchain who wants an easy way to look at data and prove they're a real, unique person online
how_its_made:
This project combines several cutting-edge technologies to create a user-friendly blockchain explorer with enhanced security and identity verification features. Here's a breakdown of the key components and how they work together:
Frontend Development
React and Next.js: The frontend is built using React for dynamic user interfaces and Next.js for server-side rendering, routing, and overall performance optimization.
Blockchain Data Retrieval
Blockscout API: This API is utilized to fetch address data and transaction information directly from the blockchain, providing users with accurate and up-to-date on-chain data.
User Authentication
Alchemy SDK: Implemented for account abstraction, allowing users to log in securely using their email addresses. This simplifies the login process while maintaining high security standards.
Identity Verification
World ID: Integrated to verify user identity and prove human uniqueness. This adds an extra layer of security and helps prevent Sybil attacks or bot activity.
By piecing these technologies together, we've created a robust platform that offers secure login, detailed blockchain data analysis, and identity verification in one cohesive package. The use of Alchemy for account abstraction and World ID for identity verification particularly enhances the project's security and user-friendliness, setting it apart from traditional blockchain explorers.
